requirements: BFD small, MGnify 2022-05, UniRef90 2022-05 and UniProt 2021-04 for protein searches
NT-RNA 2023-02-23, Rfam 14.9 and RNAcentral clustered snapshot for RNA searches
PDB seqres and mmCIF snapshot dated 2022-09-28 for templates
Chemical Component Dictionary distributed with the runtime source; validate its source revision separately
alphafold3.gpu_contract: Run data pipeline in CPU queue with run_data_pipeline=true/run_inference=false; pass immutable output JSON plus manifest digest to GPU inference with run_data_pipeline=false.

requirements: Precomputed protein/RNA MSA supplied as lowercase a3m or csv; first row must equal the query and at most three databases are accepted per protein
Optional structural templates supplied as CIF content
CCD codes are request-level identifiers resolved by the runtime; no external CCD mirror is declared by the NIM contract
openfold3-nim.gpu_contract: Supply validated MSA/template content derived from immutable preprocessing output; the NIM must not call a public MSA endpoint.

requirements: common archive containing CCD/components.cif and processed RDKit component cache
Protein MSA with taxonomy-bearing paired and unpaired A3M output
PDB seqres 2022-09-28 plus mmCIF structures for template search
Rfam 14.9, RNAcentral and NT-RNA 2023-02-23 clustered snapshots for RNA MSA
protenix-v2.gpu_contract: Run protenix inputprep on CPU and supply its immutable JSON/A3M/template result references to protenix pred.

requirements: Optional A3M for the full MSA-conditioned checkpoint; templates are not supported
esmfold2-full.gpu_contract: Replace the upstream wrapper's api.colabfold.com default with the immutable private A3M result.

requirements: Single sequence only; the Fast checkpoint has no MSA encoder and rejects MSA use
esmfold2-fast.gpu_contract: Pass the immutable sequence object directly; no MSA or reference database allocation.

requirements: Mosaic is an orchestrator: requirements are the union of the selected OpenFold3, Boltz, Protenix or ESMFold2 backend
Binder chains are MSA-free; target-chain MSA is optional by backend
Current upstream ESMFold2 and Boltz adapters default to api.colabfold.com and therefore require an integration override before private production use
mosaic.gpu_contract: Production admission must reject use_msa=true until a private precomputed-MSA adapter is selected; public service use is explicit opt-in only.

boltzgen.upstream: HannesStark/boltzgen@31d9d9b9c72245b4ed6fe8742d6fbf4e1a3552a0 (v0.3.2 reference-data contract; runtime owner must independently qualify the selected image/checkpoints)
requirements: Pinned mols.zip small-molecule dictionary for ligand/CCD-aware inference protocols
Immutable customer target PDB/mmCIF or sequence; designed binder chains remain MSA-free
A private target-chain A3M may be supplied only when the selected folding/validation step enables MSA
boltzgen.gpu_contract: Pre-stage the molecule dictionary and any private target MSA; pass immutable paths/digests so boltzgen download and MSA discovery never run while a GPU is allocated.

proteina-complexa.upstream: NVIDIA-Digital-Bio/proteina-complexa@54058860d43444c7289873f77d3e50b5b02348cd (reference-data observation only; runtime owner must qualify the selected image/checkpoints)
requirements: Immutable customer target PDB/mmCIF and ligand inputs; no shared genetic or MSA database is declared by the inference pipeline
CCD handling and AF2/RF3 evaluation assets are runtime artifacts and must be pinned by the runtime manifest rather than downloaded by a GPU job
proteina-complexa.gpu_contract: Pass target/ligand objects by immutable digest and mount already-staged entitled runtime artifacts; no reference-data download or MSA CPU work occurs in the GPU allocation.

requirements: Immutable customer-provided target PDB; design and validation are MSA-free/single-sequence
bindcraft.gpu_contract: Pass target PDB by immutable digest; AlphaFold2/ProteinMPNN weights are runtime artifacts, not shared reference databases.

requirements: No genetic/MSA/template database; optional motif or target structure is an immutable customer input
rfdiffusion.gpu_contract: Pass input PDB and contig specification by immutable digest; checkpoints remain runtime artifacts.

sharing.mode: do-not-alias-across-different-snapshot-dates; deduplicate blobs only when SHA-256 matches
